description_en: Former aviation field, 1+1 apartment for sale, 5th floor of a new residential building with 2 elevators, near Agron bar. The apartment is invested. Consisting of living room and kitchen, bedroom, bathroom with window, storage room. Overlooking the pedestrian street. With mortgage. Not sold on credit. Price=120,000 euros!
